pending_confirmation: Expanded vector IDs are recorded individually in suite 2.1.1; cross-team adoption of this executable manifest and its exact fixture hashes remains pending.
Team 12's received clean.xlsx is not adopted: an independent reading finds six findings (docs/evidence/phase4_team12_clean_review.md).
LINK_TEXT destination comparison uses the trimmed, collapsed, casefolded label against the trimmed, casefolded destination (tester/phase4/policy.py).
APPLY to COLOR_CONTRAST/MERGED_CELLS findings expects 422 UNSUPPORTED_CORRECTION (safe-profile check before value shape); the pod must confirm the check order.
HYPERLINK formula links target the indexed c element (#xml=...); an in-cell picture inside a dense range makes TABLE_HEADER manual. Pod confirmation needed.
Cross-sheet conditional formulas live in the x14 extension (xm:f) and are rewritten by renames like main-namespace formulas.
A STALE_AUDIT answer while the competing re-audit is still PROCESSING is a fail; if the re-audit already finished, the case is skipped as unobservable.
known_deviations: HTTP-only run: C9 review UI and Excel no-repair behavior are not established here.
Local-integration (24) and manual-release (10) plan entries are outside this report.
Human fixture/Excel review was not performed; no approval is inferred from automated results.
